papers.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract: Open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family with Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants delivering competitive performance in text-to-image generation, fast inference, and instruction-based editing with bilingual text rendering.

papers.title: PolicyShiftGuard: Benchmarking and Improving Policy-Adaptive Image Guardrails
papers.abstract: Comprehensive benchmark and method for policy-adaptive image guardrailing where models must decide if images violate supplied safety policies and generalize to held-out policy definitions using two-stage training combining randomized policy SFT with boundary-pair adaptation.

papers.title: MetaView: Monocular Novel View Synthesis with Scale-Aware Implicit Geometry Priors
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based monocular novel view synthesis framework combining implicit geometry modeling with explicit 3D cues using implicit geometry priors and metric depth for geometry consistency and precise controllability under large viewpoint changes.

papers.title: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch
papers.abstract: Enhanced action-centered World Action Model for robot control using mixed AC-WM and WAM training strategy with Mixture-of-Transformers architecture for efficient inference while preserving benefits of future visual dynamics supervision during training.

papers.title: Registers Matter for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Study showing register tokens benefit pixel-space Diffusion Transformers differently than Vision Transformers, producing cleaner feature maps at high noise levels and proposing Register Guidance technique to amplify register contributions for improved visual structure.

papers.title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
papers.abstract: Comprehensive survey framing self-improving agents as adaptive systems converting experience into capability gains, organizing work by update target and driving signals while discussing applications, evaluation, and future directions for autonomous agent evolution.

papers.title: Hallo4D: Multi-Modal Hallucination Mitigation for Consistent Spatio-Temporal Generation
papers.abstract: Unified framework leveraging large multimodal language models to identify and mitigate spatial and temporal inconsistencies in 3D and 4D generation through generation-detection-correction paradigm with consensus-driven optimization and motion-aware sampling.

papers.title: AgentCompass: A Unified Evaluation Infrastructure for Agent Capabilities
papers.abstract: Open-source lightweight infrastructure organizing LLM-based agent evaluation around independent Benchmark, Harness, and Environment components with fault-tolerant asynchronous runtime and trajectory analysis tools supporting 20+ benchmarks.

papers.title: Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract: Proactive egocentric assistance system with EgoMemo agent maintaining multi-scale temporal summaries, semantic knowledge graphs, and visual embeddings for context-dependent reasoning about when and whether to intervene with grounded responses.

papers.title: Tracing Agentic Failure from the Flow of Success
papers.abstract: Unsupervised failure attribution method using one-class learning with neural controlled differential equations to identify error steps by detecting deviations from dynamics learned exclusively on successful trajectories, 200-5000x faster than prompting baselines.

cc_updates.body: Added `--forward-subagent-text` flag and `CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT` environment variable to include subagent text and thinking in stream-json output. Fixed permission previews relayed to chat channels not neutralizing bidirectional-override, zero-width, and look-alike quote characters. Fixed auto mode overriding a PreToolUse hook's `ask` decision for unsandboxed Bash. Fixed parallel Claude Code sessions logging out simultaneously after wake-from-sleep. Fixed plugin MCP servers not reconnecting after idle web session woke. Fixed Claude Code on Vertex and Bedrock attempting default Opus model at startup. Fixed subagents spawned with explicit model override reverting to parent's model. Fixed nested `.claude/rules/*.md` files loading when sources exclude project settings. Fixed file upload validation for DOS device suffixes and trailing dots. Fixed file uploads to Claude in Chrome from remote and CLI sessions.

Added live elapsed-time counter to collapsed tool summary line for long-running tool calls. Added startup warning for `Write(path)`, `NotebookEdit(path)`, and `Glob(path)` permission rules. Fixed `isolation: 'worktree'` subagents running git-mutating commands against main repo. Fixed `ultracode` keyword opt-in firing on non-human-originated input. Fixed paste markers leaking into external editors. Fixed `claude attach` failing with job/agent errors during transitions. Fixed session crash when tool's result renderer returned numeric bigint. Fixed hook callback timeout misreported as user rejection. Fixed Claude assuming `cd` took effect after backgrounded command. Fixed plugin-provided MCP servers torn down during re-sync. Fixed plan approvals without edits labeled as edited by user.
Fixed `/model` and other dialogs being blocked in `claude agents` background sessions (reverted overly broad guard).
